errors.message: line 3: say which pattern, for example "pixels = pattern ghost" (a pattern Studio sent to the board).
line 4: "ghost/2" is not a pattern's name. A name has at most 32 letters, digits, spaces and - _ ( ).
line 5: "a name that is far too long for a board" is not a pattern's name. A name has at most 32 letters, digits, spaces and - _ ( ).
line 6: say which button, for example "pixels press clue1" (a button of the pattern the strip shows).
line 7: "clue*1" is not a button's name. A name has at most 32 letters, digits, spaces and - _ ( ).
line 8: a button press has no "=": write "pixels press clue1".
line 9: a button press has no "=": write "pixels press clue1".
line 10: write it as "pixels = pattern ghost".
